caption: The drawing features a woman seated in a carriage that is attached to two horses. The carriage has a rounded shape and is colored primarily in shades of dark green, red, and black, with the interior shaded in brown and some gold accents. The wheels of the carriage are large and outlined in black. The woman inside the carriage has brown hair and is wearing a yellow gown with green and red patterns. The two horses in front of the carriage are colored gray with black hooves, red harnesses, red nostrils, and their manes and tails are shaded darker gray. The horses are positioned on a green rectangular platform with four wheels, outlined in black, which matches the carriage wheels. The background is plain and beige, and the entire composition is set within a simple rectangular border on the page.
title: Calash
